messages:
anya: quick sync — sales asked for a light-weight onramp: 30-day 'starter window' that gives customers an elevated per-minute quota for new projects. idea is to reduce churn during first 2 weeks. thoughts?

mike: Can we do a rolling window vs calendar month? rolling is easier on infra for burst smoothing.

jordan: customer ask came from a couple of startups — they want predictable slack for launch. they prefer a 30-day contiguous window post signup, not calendar.

anya: ok so spec: 30-day contiguous elevated quota (X tokens/min route-level) that auto-reverts. Need to decide limits, telemetry hooks, and contract language.

mike: implementation notes: we'd need per-account state for window start + a flag to route into priority lane. also rate-limits + quota counters per route. rollout risk: higher ops load if many start windows active.

anya: tradeoffs noted. Jordan — legal asks whether simple clause is ok or we need add-on SKU.

sylvia: prefer add-on SKU with a free promo line item for first 30 days. reason: accounting + audit trail. Clause example: "Starter Window: A temporary elevated throughput allowance for new projects for 30 days from account activation, provided at no additional charge for customers on eligible plans."

jordan: customers hate surprise line items; offering it as "promo" is fine as long as it auto-expires. sales wants a single toggle in Console to enable/disable per-customer.

mike: backend needs an API + Console flag. default ON for self-serve signups, opt-out via support or console. Could be simple: feature flag + per-customer expiry timestamp.

anya: launch criteria proposal — must satisfy all: (1) telemetry shows <2x baseline  p95 latency increase during pilot, (2) <= 3 billing disputes in pilot cohort, (3) Console toggle + API present, (4) docs + contract language approved.

sylvia: add: update T&Cs snippet and invoicing metadata for promo SKUs. I can draft.

ops-bot: deploy-candidate: "starter-window-v1" built. canary to 5% tomorrow at 09:00 UTC.

mike: will monitor token throughput + latency traces. plan to ramp to 25% after 24h if stable.

anya: FYI — customers pushing for extension options (e.g., extend by 15 days). What do we offer?

jordan: propose manual extension via Sales, documented as one-time extension + recorded invoice note. customers liked manual for negotiations.

sylvia: manual extension needs approval guardrails. we'll add a standard extension template and retention policy.

anya: Decision recap: implement rolling 30-day starter window as promo SKU, Console toggle default ON, manual extension via Sales with template, rollout if launch criteria met. Action items: Mike: API + canary, Sylvia: contract snippet, Jordan: pilot cohort + customer comms, Anya: update PRD + launch checklist.

mike: noted. will post canary logs to #eng-runtime and link here.

jordan: I'll line up 4 pilot customers this week.

sylvia: I'll share draft clause by EOD.

anya: Thanks — syncing again after canary results. :thumbsup:
